description.purpose: The last cell of a lane, as one code cell: it accepts anything and emits nothing. Its whole job is to be an address, so that a lane which has no destination yet still HAS a destination -- the message arrives, the trace records it, and the dead-letter queue stays empty.
description.use_when: Once per colony while lanes are still being decided, or permanently for lanes whose only consumer is the trace. Instantiate it under any name -- `sink` is the usual one -- and point every outbound lane at it that has nowhere else to go.
description.not_in_scope: No storage, no forwarding, no retry, no judgement, no reply to the caller. It is a stop, not a component: the moment a lane knows where it belongs, it stops pointing here.
examples: PORTS - Entry: any turn on any lane. Exit: nothing (empty multi-send, terminal).
four lanes, one terminal: an answer, a rejection, an error and a drained episode all end here while the tree is being built -- four different decisions, none of them made yet
read the arrivals: GET /ui/trace shows each of them with its own hop chain, which is why swallowing loses nothing
